Class MediaSource

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.client.media.MediaSource
public final class MediaSource extends Object
An encoded source. Resource and HTTP bytes are opened only by the decoding worker, never by the draw callback.

      public Path materialize(long maxBytes, MediaCancellation cancellation) throws IOException
      Resolves a seekable local path. Temporary source files are deleted by the generation after its processes close.
      Parameters:
